 Jordan Ellis Mon 19 October 2026 11:59 Follow us on Google Discover Lucero Acosta is celebrating despite her PFL debut ending in a stoppage defeat. 
 The 32-year-old from Mexico fought Shannon Clark (9-1) at PFL Chicago on Saturday night. 
 Just under two minutes into round three, the referee stepped in and waved off the fight as the blood-soaked Lucero Acosta was deemed to be in no fit state to continue.

 Lucero Acosta is an OnlyFans star who was sponsored by the content hosting platform for her PFL Chicago debut.
 Shannon Clark’s opponent inadvertently went viral for something that happened during the final moments of their fight. 
 One of Acosta’s breasts popped out as she suffered a wardrobe malfunction while Clark was beating the hell out of her.
 SHANNON CLARK SHOWS NO MERCY 🔥
#PFLChicago | Early Card LIVE NOW on ESPN App | Main Card 11 PM EST on ESPN 2 https://t.co/6M4tVuFM6o
— PFL (@PFLMMA) October 17, 2026 View Tweet Naturally, footage of the finishing sequence spread around the internet like wildfire, earning Acosta an unexpected bonus. 
 “Extra payment on @onlyfans because we showed our nipples during the @pflmma live. It’s cute. Official sponsor,” the 6-3 fighter wrote on Instagram.
 Acosta shared the post to her Instagram with a caption that hinted at how much money she made. 
 “500k,” she added.
 I think Lucero Acosta got a $500,000 bonus from OnlyFans because her boob popped out 👀
Warning: This will trigger the Dana Haters for not doing the same for all his fighters.
